name: Destroy the Castle
summary: Destroy the Castle is another cool physics-based castle crushing game. Your mission is simple: Destroy every Castle with your cannon! Move your mouse up and down to set the position of the muzzle. Change the shooting power by moving your mouse left and right. You'll have a certain number of cannons at your disposal, and you'll have to make sure that your enemy is completely destroyed before you run out of ammunition. To do this, you'll be able to adjust your catapult.
